description: This file defines the `ParserEventLog` class, a specialized parser for event log data, extending an abstract parser, incorporating external modules for event handling, timestamp processing, and trace type identification, and implementing methods for trace type retrieval, magic number verification, decoding buffers into events, timestamp extraction, and processing decoded entries.
